description: PHP unit test class 'LDAPServiceAnonBindTest' for testing LDAP anonymous binding functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up mock configurations, tests anonymous connection capabilities, and verifies permission restrictions for LDAP config modifications.

classes.name: LDAPServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying LDAP anonymous binding and configuration permissions within OrangeHRM's LDAP service integration.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up LDAP server configuration before any tests run; skips tests if LDAP server isn't configured.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, ensuring LDAP server is configured and data is loaded.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Mocks LDAP settings, configures the LDAP server for anonymous binding, and loads test LDAP user data.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests if LDAP anonymous bind is successful by creating a service instance and binding with empty credentials.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Attempts to modify LDAP global configuration as an anonymous user, expects an exception due to insufficient permissions.

methods.name: testChangeGlobalConfigUsingAdminUser
methods.description: Attempts to modify LDAP global configuration as an admin user, expects a permission error exception.
